theme.title: Mixed / Stock-Picker's Market
theme.summary: Materials (+1.61%) and Communication Svcs (+1.40%) led the market today, while Real Estate (-0.79%) and Technology (-0.22%) brought up the rear. Performance didn't cluster cleanly by style — growth averaged +0.45%, defensives +0.39%, and value/cyclicals +0.40% — more a stock-by-stock market than a single broad theme. Major indices moved in a tighter band — S&P 500 +0.46%, Dow +0.56%, Nasdaq +0.45% — without one clearly dominating. Small caps bucked the broader trend, with the Russell 2000 up +1.13%, outperforming large caps. The VIX fell 6.92% to 15.20, which reads as an orderly rotation rather than panic-driven selling. Gold added 1.85% to $4,429.30, crude oil was little changed at $90.77, and bitcoin slipped 0.50% — cross-asset moves weren't all pointing the same direction as equities.
